defects: R1 (consequential) Non-lipid families 'keep their v1.6 reading ... wherever they are listed', and W-RICH's partner needs only to be 'present and plausibly persistent, wherever it is listed'. It is unclear whether a lane may still discount a trace post-fragrance silicone/cationic in depositionLoad/persistence, as both v1.6 lanes did for P40 (and lane B did for A13 in v1.4). Strict reading: P40 W-RICH + weak reset -> high. Fix: one sentence saying whether position may still inform depositionLoad/persistence for non-lipid families (W-RICH partner 'plausibly persistent' judgment).

R2 (record only) Capryloyl Glycine is not a candidate, but its surfactant status for W-LINE (ii) is undecided in the text; C3's unlisted-surfactant rule (acylate -> mild anionic) could make P34 Piroctone Olamine@19 implausible -> W-line 32. Band unaffected. Fix: say it is not a cleansing surfactant for (ii), or accept both records.
